origin: Claude Code 2.1.168: the relay breaks off the answer with an error that names its host, its URL, its key and a piece of the prompt; none of it may reach the client. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and the thinking fields are those Claude Code sends for it (adaptive, effort high).
